(2) The woman stops flipping the food and brings the tongs close to her face, appearing to shout or react dramatically. A large text overlay in English and Chinese flashes on the screen. They both begin to grill the food extremely rapidly and frantically, with steam rising from the grill. Their movements are exaggerated and synchronized in a chaotic, comedic fashion.
